issue.title: highlights::overwrite_local tests fail on master since 5c9b6e42 (minute-precision captured stamp): replacement no longer refreshes or keeps captured as asserted
issue.description:
Two `highlights::overwrite_local` CLI tests fail on bob-cli master. They started with
`5c9b6e42` ("feat(highlights)!: stamp minute-precision captured time in every ref create
marker"), a standalone tale from athena agent `181` that landed without a lander. That
commit also edited `tests/cli/highlights/overwrite_local.rs`, but both tests still fail
on every CI run since then.

Failing tests (CI run 41900846465 on `87eecb1a`; same failures in 41885917671 on `5c9b6e4`):

- `highlights::overwrite_local::local_pdf_overwrite_replaces_in_place_without_archive`
  panics at `tests/cli/highlights/overwrite_local.rs:655` with
  "replacement keeps the stem id and refreshes captured".
- `highlights::overwrite_local::overwrite_same_stem_source_selects_named_member` panics
  at `tests/cli/highlights/overwrite_local.rs:1658` with
  "v2 keeps its stamp after the named overwrite".

Likely area (not yet confirmed): the overwrite path and the new minute-precision
`captured` stamp (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm±ZZZZ`) disagree. Either overwrite no longer refreshes
`captured` the way the test expects, or the assertion still compares the old date-only
form. Decide which contract is intended (refresh to a minute stamp on overwrite, or keep
the original), then fix the code or the test and document the rule in
`docs/highlights-ref-sync.md`.

Impact: together with in-flight epic red (h0 fixture, h2 fmt/clippy), these keep bob-cli
master CI red. The Release train has not shipped since `v0.4.0` (2026-10-27). Unlike the
epic-owned failures, no running agent or lander owns these two.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic assertion failures on every CI run since 5c9b6e42 (runs 41885917671 and 41900846465) at the same lines with the same messages; no rerun has passed.

issue.creation_reason: The lead researcher of the research.3b bead-triage swarm confirmed these two failures in master CI with no owning bead or running agent; they keep master and the release train red after the epic-owned failures clear.
